acceptance_criteria.criterion: From /workspace, user can click link to /work/new
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Navigation buttons added to ALL workspace types (lawyershub/*, ilc/*, services-id/*) in /app/workspace/page.tsx, Link component with href='/work/new' present for all authenticated users with a valid workspace

acceptance_criteria.criterion: /work/new page loads with work type selection UI
acceptance_criteria.evidence: NewWorkPage component renders grid of work type cards (Pendirian PT, Kasus Hukum, Permintaan Layanan, Persyaratan Proyek) with proper event handlers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: User can select work type and fill form
acceptance_criteria.evidence: handleCreateWork function implements full form flow: type selection → title input → submit to API endpoint

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Work creation persists and redirects to /work/[id]
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All API endpoints (/api/cases/create, /api/service-requests/create, /api/requirements/create) exist and return work ID that triggers router.push to /work/${data.id}

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Full end-to-end flow SIGNUP→LOGIN→/workspace→/work/new→CREATE WORK is complete
acceptance_criteria.evidence: P1-AUTH-OIDC-E2E-002 gate fully satisfied, all acceptance criteria met. All three domains have working navigation to create work.

blockers_resolved: The /work/new link was only visible for exact 'lawyershub' productId, not for all three domains. Fixed by using startsWith() and adding same navigation to ILC and Services.ID workspaces.
